fix_subject: Fix fuzzer issue 35: correctly check overflows on casts from float/double to unsigned integers
pr_title: Fix fuzzer issue 35: correctly check overflows on casts from float/double to unsigned integers

labels.summary: Casts from float and double to unsigned integer types lacked proper overflow and range checks, so out-of-range values (negative or too large) were not rejected with an error; this adds explicit unsigned specializations with correct bounds.
